qualification.rationale: AMP Electric is an owner-led residential and commercial electrical contractor in Nampa, Idaho, but does not meet ForgeX's target profile. ForgeX serves owner-led home-service contractors with approximately 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. AMP Electric presents itself as a local family business and identifies only two team members on its site (Owner [redacted] and General Manager [redacted]), pointing to a small team well under 10 staff. Additionally, its digital infrastructure already incorporates LeadConnector (scripts and endpoints on leadconnectorhq.com and msgsndr.com), which inherently provides lead capture forms, online scheduling, and SMS/email communication pipelines. Any basic lead automation ForgeX would offer is already available within the company's existing platform. Per ForgeX evaluation guidelines, the company is outside the segment and already owns the relevant solution.
